edition.locus: On the Unity of the Church 23
edition.witness_note: Single locked witness in repo; second witness not yet locked.

source_text: Opto equidem, dilectissimi fratres, et consulo pariter et suadeo ut, si fieri potest, nemo de fratribus pereat et consentientis populi corpus unum gremio suo gaudens mater includat. Si tamen quosdam schismatum duces et dissensionis auctores, in caeca et obstinata dementia permanentes, non potuerit ad salutis viam consilium salubre revocare, caeteri tamen vel simplicitate capti, vel errore inducti, vel aliqua fallentis astutiae calliditate decepti, a fallaciae vos laqueis solvite, vagantes gressus ab erroribus liberate, iter rectum viae coelestis agnoscite. Contestantis Apostoli vox est: Praecipimus vobis, inquit, in nomine Domini nostri Jesu Christi ut recedatis ab omnibus fratribus ambulantibus inordinate et non secundum traditionem quam acceperunt a nobis. Et iterum dicit: Nemo vos decipiat inanibus verbis. Propterea enim venit ira Dei super filios contumaciae. Nolite ergo esse participes eorum. Recedendum est a delinquentibus, vel immo fugiendum, ne, dum quis male ambulantibus jungitur, et per itinera erroris et criminis graditur, a via veri itineris exerrans, pari crimine et ipse teneatur. Deus unus est, et Christus unus, et una Ecclesia ejus, et fides una, et plebs una in solidam corporis unitatem concordiae glutino copulata. Scindi unitas non potest, nec corpus unum discidio compaginis separari, divulsis laceratione visceribus, in frustra discerpi. Quidquid a matrice discesserit, seorsum vivere et spirare non poterit, substantiam salutis amittit.
pass_a_gloss: I truly wish, most beloved brothers, and I advise equally and persuade that, if it can be done, no one of the brothers may perish and the consenting people's body, one, rejoicing, the mother may enclose in her bosom. However, if certain leaders of schisms and authors of dissension, remaining in blind and obstinate foolishness, cannot be recalled to the path of salvation by wholesome advice, nevertheless the rest, either captured by simplicity, or led astray by error, or deceived by some cunning of deceptive cleverness, free yourselves from the snares of fallacy, liberate your wandering steps from errors, recognize the straight path of the heavenly way. The voice of the contending Apostle is: We command you, he says, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to withdraw from all brothers who walk disorderly and not according to the tradition which they received from us. And again he says: Let no one deceive you with empty words. For the wrath of God comes upon the sons of disobedience. Do not therefore be partakers of them. One must withdraw, or rather flee, from those who offend, lest, while someone joins those who walk evilly, and proceeds through the paths of error and crime, straying from the path of the true journey, he himself be held guilty of equal crime. God is one, and Christ is one, and His Church is one, and the faith is one, and the people are one, bound together into a solid unity of the body by the glue of concord. Unity cannot be torn apart, nor can the one body be separated by a division of its joints, with its inward parts torn asunder by laceration, torn to pieces. Whatever departs from the womb cannot live and breathe separately, it loses the substance of salvation.

pass_b_english: I truly wish, most beloved brothers, and I both advise and persuade you that, if it can be done, no brother may perish and the mother may enclose the one, rejoicing body of the consenting people in her bosom. Yet if certain leaders of schisms and authors of dissension, persisting in blind and obstinate folly, cannot be recalled to the path of salvation by wholesome counsel, the rest of you — whether captured by simplicity, led astray by error, or deceived by some cunning of deceptive craftiness — must free yourselves from the snares of fallacy, liberate your wandering steps from errors, and recognize the straight path of the heavenly way. The voice of the contending Apostle commands: "We command you in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to withdraw from all brothers who walk disorderly and not according to the tradition which they received from us" (2 Thessalonians 3:6). And again he says: "Let no one deceive you with empty words, for the wrath of God comes upon the sons of disobedience" (Ephesians 5:6). Therefore do not be partakers with them. One must withdraw, or rather flee, from those who offend, lest, while someone joins those who walk evilly and proceeds through the paths of error and crime, straying from the path of the true journey, he himself be held guilty of equal crime. God is one, and Christ is one, and His Church is one, and the faith is one, and the people are one, bound together into a solid unity of the body by the glue of concord. Unity cannot be torn apart, nor can the one body be separated by a division of its joints, with its inward parts torn asunder by laceration, torn to pieces. Whatever departs from the womb cannot live and breathe separately; it loses the substance of salvation.
